restaurant_name: Be-smile Chiangmai คลินิก บี-สไมล์เชียงใหม่
text:
I came here for a teeth cleaning because I saw the good reviews but I was disapointed.

Negative:
- It was not soft at all, going quick around the teeth with the machine, a bit brutal
- A regular cleaning just includes the machine around the teeth. You have to pay 200 THB extra if they use the manual pic for tartar.
- They don’t actually clean your teeth with tooth paste neither pass the floss, they really just go around the gums.
- I had water all over my face, it was dripping in my neck and the water was warm.
- They advertise a price of 700-1200 THB but you don’t know how much if will be until you are done. Even though I have quite good teeth (last cleaning 9 months ago), I was charged 900 THB).
- The cleaning only lasted 15 min.

Positive:
- They had a availability right away
- They speak good enough english
- I don’t have tartar between my bottom teeth which was the main reason I came to them.
- It’s clean.

Conclusion:
I would not come back here neither recommend it to a friend. I did not feel like it was a complete cleaning at all. I feel like it was really expensive for the service I got.

text:
Lack of Transparent Pricing - Unexpected Costs & Health Complication

I visited this clinic due to a toothache. At the initial consultation, I explicitly asked for the total cost for either an extraction or a filling. I was told a filling would be 2,500 Baht. The dentist decided to start a root canal treatment and placed a temporary filling, asking me to return the following week.

Upon my return for the next appointment, I was informed that the 2,500 Baht fee was per session and that the total cost for the complete treatment would be significantly higher (around 10,000 Baht). This was not communicated to me initially when I asked for the total cost. Had I known the full price from the start, I could have planned my budget or considered other options.

The disagreement over these unexpected costs and the subsequent delay in appointments unfortunately led to my tooth developing an infection. Ultimately, the business owner suggested refunding my money and that I should seek treatment at another clinic, which I was forced to accept.

A word of caution: If you are considering this clinic, please ensure you get a clear, written estimate for the TOTAL cost of all required procedures before any work begins. You may encounter unexpected additional charges.
